topics.description: The federal government has deferred $91 million in Medicaid funding for Minnesota due to fraud vulnerabilities. This freeze is a significant development in the ongoing investigation into Medicaid spending in the state.
topics.reason: Recent news articles report on the deferment of Medicaid funding
